Hildegard of Bingen.fact: Hildegard states that Jutta taught her to read and write, but that she was unlearned, and therefore incapable of teaching Hildegard sound Biblical interpretation.

Abbot Kuno did not relent, however, until Hildegard was stricken by an illness that rendered her paralyzed and unable to move from her bed, an event that she attributed to God's unhappiness at her not following his orders to move her nuns to Rupertsberg.

Hildegard of Bingen.fact: When the abbot declined Hildegard's proposition, Hildegard went over his head and received the approval of Archbishop Henry I of Mainz.

Hildegard of Bingen.subject: Women & Society

Hildegard of Bingen.fact: The commission found the visions authentic and returned them to the Pope, along with a portion of Scivias. Hildegard of Bingen.fact: She had already explored this area in her musical morality play, Ordo Virtutum, and the "Book of the Rewards of Life" takes up the play's characteristic themes.

Hildegard of Bingen.fact: Standing in humankind's defence, however, are the sober voices of the Virtues, powerfully confronting every vicious deception.

Iloilo Strait.fact: Iloilo City on Panay is the major city located on the strait with Buenavista and Jordan, both on Guimaras, immediately across the strait from the city. Pump boat ferries cross every few minutes from Iloilo City to Guimaras and vice versa.

Iloilo Strait.subject: Women & Society
Iloilo Strait.question: Ships doing business with the _____ of Iloilo often moor in the strait
Iloilo Strait.fact: Ships doing business with the Port of Iloilo often moor in the strait.

Iloilo Strait.subject: Women & Society
Iloilo Strait.question: Gregory The Great nearly capsized on 15 June _____, when it struck rocks under the water near the Siete Picados Islands
Iloilo Strait.fact: Gregory The Great nearly capsized on 15 June 2013, when it struck rocks under the water near the Siete Picados Islands.

Iloilo Strait.question: Hours later, the motorboat "_____" bound for Buenavista, Guimaras, also capsized due to strong winds
